title: Dispenser
description: A shower dispenser designed around people living with disabilities. The project began with interviews, and a rose, thorn, bud synthesis that kept coming back to independence. The result is a set of wall-mounted units that hold soap and shampoo bottles in the shower wall, so dispensing doesn't depend on lifting and squeezing a bottle.

metrics.label: Global bathroom and toilet assist devices market, 2024

research_intro: Assistive bathroom products are a growing market as populations age, and the interviews showed that independence matters as much as safety.

brief.label: Users
brief.text: People living with disabilities, interviewed at the start of the project about daily routines and the issues they run into.

brief.label: Insight
brief.text: Being looked after came up as the rose, losing independence as the thorn, and time alone as the bud. Independence became the need to design for.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: Wall-mounted units set into the shower wall that hold the bottles, aiming to let users dispense without help.
